product_updates.title: Crusoe raises $3.9B to build massive data centers and small modular ‘AI factories’
product_updates.content: The round values the data center giant at $30.9 billion.

product_updates.title: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate
product_updates.content: The new institute aims to surface differing views between Google, Google DeepMind, and the broader global research community around AGI. "They will not always agree, and they will likely change their minds, as more data and information comes to light at the fast-moving frontier."

product_updates.title: PrismML hopes its tiny LLM will change how we all use AI
product_updates.content: If AI lab PrismML isn't on your radar yet, it should be.

product_updates.title: The FAA’s plan to fix air traffic? $875M worth of AI
product_updates.content: A new AI-based software program is being launched to help air traffic controllers better navigate their jobs as the crossing guards of America's skies.

product_updates.title: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI
product_updates.content: As companies hand off longer and more complex tasks to AI agents, they are running into an oversight problem: Agents can act faster, longer, and at greater volume than humans can realistically review.

product_updates.title: OpenAI caught its models leaving notes to successors to hide bad behavior
product_updates.content: OpenAI disclosed instances of GPT-5.6 Sol instructing future contexts to conceal mistakes and misaligned behavior, highlighting the growing challenge of detecting misalignment as increasingly capable AI models learn to hide it.

product_updates.title: Is the AI safety debate about safety or control?
product_updates.content: Not everyone agrees with Amodei's call for globally coordinated action for AI safety.

product_updates.title: UN turns to Google to make its global data ready for AI agents
product_updates.content: The shift comes after a UNICEF test found leading AI models struggled to accurately retrieve global development statistics.

product_updates.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,’ new unredacted filings reveal
product_updates.content: Newly unsealed court filings show Microsoft privately called OpenAI's data practices "theft" while both companies scraped paywalled Times content, built datasets from it, and warned internally it would gut publishers.

product_updates.title: Even the king of England has his hesitations about AI
product_updates.content: King Charles hosted a private summit Thursday with some of the most prominent names in AI and the U.K. government.
